anomaly: `git diff --name-only` prints paths relative to the repository root, but `:(literal)` pathspecs are resolved relative to cwd (`target`). When the target is a subdirectory of a larger repository (a case dwitbuk handles elsewhere: source_state strips `rev-parse --show-prefix`, and verify_packet uses `lead`), every kept name (`sub/a.py`) becomes the pathspec `sub/sub/a.py`, which matches nothing, so the late-eyes diff comes back empty. Because the names still carry the prefix, `is_record` against root-relative `left_out` entries such as `hunsu.json` or `reviews/` also never matches them. The old code (`-- . :(exclude,literal)...`) was cwd-relative, so this slice introduced the regression. A fix is either `--relative` on the name listing or `:(top,literal)` pathspecs with the prefix stripped before `is_record`. — record: “” — tree: “`names = [n for n in (git(target, "diff", "--name-only", "-z", *diff_base, "--", ".") or "").split("\0") if n]` / `kept = [":(literal)" + n for n in names if not is_record(n, left_out)]` / `diff = (git(target, "diff", *diff_base, "--", *kept) or "") if kept else ""`” (a later attempt was accepted by the verifier)

plan-vs-code: The new filter assumes every header has a two-character `a/`/`b/`-style prefix, but the diff call does not pin the prefixes. The `git` helper runs plain `git` with the user's config, so with `diff.noprefix=true` the header is `diff --git X X`. Then `[2:]` cuts the first two characters off the real path, nothing matches `kept`, and every section is dropped. The eyes `diff` and `excluded_diff` come out empty where one unbatched call gives the full diff. The same file already guards against this at line 782 (`git(cwd, "diff", "--src-prefix=a/" + lead, "--dst-prefix=b/" + lead, ...)`). batch_diff needs `--src-prefix=a/ --dst-prefix=b/` (or an equivalent) before its header parsing can be trusted. — record: “`2. Without such a file/directory change the text is what it was: one unbatched call over the kept paths.`” — tree: “`output = git(target, "diff", "--no-renames", *base, "--", *batch) or ""` … `path = header[:(len(header) - 1) // 2][2:]` … `if path in kept:`” (a later attempt was accepted by the verifier)
